description: Magnesium flare: an MG rod in an OXYG atmosphere with a small FIRE igniter touching its tip.
name: mg_flare
why: Magnesium will not casually ignite (needs real heat input) but once past ~630 C it burns at ~3100 C, consuming its own OXYG neighbours per the reactive rule and producing STNE ash and PROP_HOT_GLOW white light -- the classic flare/thermite-starter reaction, and the reason this needs a dedicated OXYG pocket rather than relying on ambient air. Real magnesium fires cannot be put out with water (it reacts with burning Mg to make more hydrogen) or CO2 -- keep any suppression system away from this module.
